notes.title: v0.49.1 - Patch
notes.notes:
Toggle/Hold to sprint
I've added an option so you can change the input from the default Toggle to Sprint to Hold to Sprint

Half Rate Shading compatibility issues
Some of the post processing shaders in Midnight Mayhem are not compatible with Half Rate Shading, which is on by default on the Steam Deck.

I've added a warning popup explaining this when the game is started on the Steam Deck

Change list:

🎉 Added an option to change between Toggle/Hold to sprint
🔧 Added a link icon to the voice chat help document button
🔧 Added a warning regarding issues with Half Rate Shading on Steam Deck
🔧 Improved main menu and options menu up down navigation

🔧 Implemented a failsafe system in case lag causes the Monster to get stuck mid air
🔧 Fixed a bug when entering text on Steam Deck

notes.title: v0.49.0 - Controller patch & player settings rework
notes.notes:
Player settings rework
Previously the Mute buttons were under Audio settings and the Kick button under Misc.

This has been improved heavily, all player options are now under the new options tab "Players". 

There are 4 buttons for each player:
- Open Steam profile
- Mute player
- Kick player (host only)
- Block player

Additionally there is a green outline that becomes visible when a player is talking, making it easier to see who is who.
Controller menu navigation patch
A lot of issues have been fixed with controller menu navigation, especially in the main menu

Change list:

🔧 Changed "Misc." options to "Interface"
🔧 Added "Players" tab to the Options menu
🎉 Added options to open steam profile, mute, kick or block fellow players
🎉 Added a system that saves the last 20 people you played with
🎉 Added an indicator showing which player is speaking in the Player Options
🎉 Added a community guidelines popup
🎮 Nerfed zombies in the Dungeon map
🎮 Very slightly nerfed sliding speed when spamming
🔧 Improved main menu user experience by making focus go back to the last selected button
🔧 Fixed monster player being able to walk on water in the Dungeon
🔧 Fixed player left notifications for clients
🔧 Fixed a bug when using Absorb Light Source and then turning off the Fusebox
🔧 Fixed some widgets in the main menu not being affected by interface scale setting
🔧 Fixed not being able to use the back button to go out of some menus in the main menu
🔧 Fixed a few controller bugs in the main menu

notes.title: v0.45.4 - Patch
notes.notes:
Crashing bug fix
In rare cases the game would freeze and crash instantly when the monster was killed, this should now be fixed.

However, I can only be sure of this if there are no more reports, so if you still encounter this issue please let me know!

Spectator jittering fix
For a long time there has been the issue of jittery camera movement for spectators, this should finally be fixed once and for all!

Small HUD improvements
There have been a few small HUD improvements like adding a mic icon in the top right when using Push To Talk and improving the ability meter visually.

And of course other bug fixes and small improvements

Change list:

🔧 Bug where the game would freeze and crash when the marionette was killed should now be fixed
✨ Added a small gradient to the ability meter, more clearly indicating when it's ready to use
✨ Monster can now kill a human directly while mimicking
✨ Moved the prompt for turning back into marionette when mimicking to be more centered
✨ Improved spectating, you can now see the entire HUD, flashlight battery, ammo, secondary etc...
✨ Added a microphone icon to the HUD when using Push To Talk
🔧 Improved the connection error screen
🔧 Disabled Lantern collision
🔧 Added a very small cooldown to sliding, fixing boost sliding bug
🔧 Fixed jittering when spectating
🔧 Fixed the stalking distance not being calculated correctly when using Mimic Human
🔧 Fixed a bug when the marionette was on the attic ladder while it was interacted with
🔧 Fixed a bug where tips still appeared when spectating another player
🔧 Fixed a rare bug where Shadow Stalker attacked two players at the same time
🔧 Fixed bug when switching to secondary while flashlight is affected by Absorb Light Source

notes.title: v0.45.1 - Patch
notes.notes:
Balancing improvements
The monster can no longer die from being too far from the humans in the final phase.
The monster is now slightly faster than humans when wounded.
Isolation ability has been buffed.
And other small balancing tweaks.

Improved water death
The screen used to cut to black when you fell into the water, this has been removed and you can now keep seeing as you sink to the bottom. Also added proper underwater post processing, splash sound effects and underwater audio effects.

Small tutorial improvements
Some things have been clarified in the tutorial, tips and the ability loadout menu.

And of course quite a few bug fixes

Change list:

🎉 Heavily improved dying in the water in the Dungeon, no longer cuts to black
🔧 The monster is now slightly faster than humans when wounded
🔧 Isolation ability now lasts longer
🔧 In the final phase the monster can no longer die from being far from humans
🔧 Added a tip telling humans they sometimes need to split up
🔧 Added some text to the tutorial telling humans they sometimes need to split up
🔧 Removed the first "Monster Evolved" notification for humans
🔧 Made the ability loadout menu text bigger and more easily readable
🔧 Some balancing improvements
🔧 Fixed a bug in the Dungeon when crouching while above the water
🔧 Fixed the Fangworm being affected by decals
🔧 Fixed decapitated heads being affected by decals
🔧 Fixed character customization settings not being initialized properly

notes.title: v0.44.1 - Patch & Improvements
notes.notes:
Different ability loadouts per map
The ability loadout menu now has separate loadouts for each map. This allows you to choose the abilities you find most useful for each map separately.

Up to 6 players
The game is now also playable with up to 6 people instead of 4, please be aware that 5 and 6 player games have been tested the least so balancing will probably need some work!

And a bunch of bug fixes

Important:
The demo is being disabled June 1st,
The full game is releasing June 3rd!

Change list:

🎉 You can now create a different ability loadout for each map
🎉 The game is now playable with up to 6 people total balancing still needs to be done
🔧 Changed the controller Joystick Deadzone default value
🔧 Lowered some environment sounds in the Amusement Park

notes.title: Major development update!
notes.notes:
It's about time for another development update on the full game!

I'm covering all the changes since the last development update post, so some of these were already covered in patch notes

The biggest changes:

🎉 New trailer
🎉 7 New monster abilities (15 total)
🎉 2 New maps (4 total)
🎉 2 New secondary items (5 total)
🎉 1 New main weapon (4 total)
🎉 4 New masks (8 total)
🎉 HUD redesign
🎮 Many gameplay and QoL improvements
🔧 Many bug fixes

And a lot more!

What's next?
With all of this new content it's once again time to work on some important but less flashy stuff!

Here are some of the things I will be focusing on now:

🔧 Fixing bugs
🔧 Balancing the game
🔧 Setting up things like achievements for the full game


Please try the demo and let me know what you think! Community feedback has already helped me improve the game a lot :)
